subject.title: fix(polls): reject polls with fewer than two options

question: Should the public `resolvePollMaxSelections` helper reject zero- and one-option multiselect polls to match `normalizePollInput`, or intentionally return capped 0/1 values for those invalid inputs?
rationale: Both behaviors are externally observable through the plugin SDK, and the latest branch contradicts the previous rejection-oriented review/proof, so a mechanical merge cannot safely select the lasting contract.

options.title: Reject invalid option counts
options.body: Make the helper throw the established minimum-two-options error for 0/1 multiselect counts and keep the current valid-input behavior.

options.title: Adopt capped invalid results
options.body: Keep 0/1 return values only with explicit SDK contract approval, caller compatibility analysis, and updated documentation and proof showing why invalid polls may proceed.

recommendation.title: Reject invalid option counts
recommendation.body: Make the helper throw the established minimum-two-options error for 0/1 multiselect counts and keep the current valid-input behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: Feature-history ownership for the helper must be established from the introduction commit before assigning the API decision.
